Pharmacopoeias. In Eur. (see p.vii). Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Citronella Oil). The oil obtained by steam distilla- tion from the fresh or partially dried aerial parts of Cymbopogon winterianus. It contains 30.0 to 45.0% citronellal, 9.0 to 15.0% citronellol, 2.0 to 4.0% citronellyl acetate, less than 2.0% gerani- al, 20.0 to 25.0% geraniol, 3.0 to 8.0% geranyl acetate, 1.0 to 5.0% limonene, and less than 2.0% neral. A pale yellow to brownish-yellow liquid with a very strong odour of citronellal. Store in well-filled containers. Protect from light. Profile Citronella oil is used as a perfume and insect repellent. It is also used in aromatherapy. Hypersensitivity has been reported.
